name: BACH_0251
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (>99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class set, second-model agreement and 5/5 similar cases all favor Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal >99%, Benign <1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 62nd percentile | Typical, usable image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest concept term; scored above typical · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Scores above typical · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scores above typical · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable (AI spot check 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Benign epithelial fraction is at the 4th percentile [F7] and failed its direction check; only 3 regions sampled.
- Validation set is small (132 images); calibration error CI reaches 0.18.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8, 11**: confirm benign epithelium is present; the measured fraction is low.
2. **Regions 3, 8, 11**: verify two-layered lobules yourself; the concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 0**: strongest infiltrating-stroma score; exclude an invasive focus.
